run_record_aggregate_metrics_and_videos: run record_aggregate_metrics_and_videos to generate MP4 videos and aggregate logs from robot trajectory step data
run_record_aggregate_metrics: run record_aggregate_metrics to compute path length, collisions, and steps from step log JSON files
run_record_video: run record_video to encode a list of image files into an MP4 video with optional realtime frame pacing
run_cli_modular: run the script with argument modular to process modular_learned and modular_frontier trajectory paths and print aggregate stats
run_cli_end_to_end: run the script with argument end_to_end to process end_to_end trajectory paths and print aggregate stats
